versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the senior-frontend skill, providing a comprehensive workflow for production-ready, pixel-perfect frontend design and development.
- Integrates Next.js, Tailwind CSS, and shadcn/ui as the core technology stack.
- Details a step-by-step process merging design thinking, UX best practices, accessibility, animation, and real-world design systems.
- Supplies clear guidelines for design token creation, unique font and color palette selection, and dark mode best practices.
- Recommends component architecture patterns and starting points, including shadcn/ui installation commands.
- Outlines layout strategies for different types of pages, emphasizing intentionality and professional execution.
